title: THE CATHEDRAL
note: Draft from the owner's Hebrew treatment (8.11.2026), fact-checked; see the script document for every correction. Panels are still to be drawn.

beats.say: In nineteen ninety-one the most wanted man in the world built his own prison. It had a football pitch. And by his own account, Diego Maradona played on it.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: June nineteen ninety-one. Pablo Escobar surrenders to the Colombian state — into a prison on a hill above Medellín that he had a hand in building. They called it La Catedral.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: At its heart, a floodlit pitch with small goals. Escobar staged games there, and footballers were brought up the mountain to play.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: Óscar Pareja, captain of Independiente Medellín, was one. He said Escobar played left midfield, even though he was right-footed.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: Maradona in nineteen ninety-one is banned from football for fifteen months after a positive test in Italy.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: In interviews years later, he told it like this: an offer, a lot of money, a game for "an important man". A trip into the mountains. A fortress full of guards.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: A game, he said, and then a party — "with the best girls I've ever seen in my life. And it was in a prison."
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: But Maradona also told the other version. "I never met Pablo Escobar," he said to the Argentine paper Olé. "I swear it on my mother."
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: So which Diego do you believe? The file keeps both — because he gave both.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: In July nineteen ninety-two Escobar walked out of La Catedral. Seventeen months later he was dead. The pitch is still on the hill.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.
